question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who underperformed their xG by the most (xG minus goals)?
answer: Darwin Núñez underperformed his xG by the most among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024: 11 goals, 19.188 xG, for an xG minus goals of 8.188.
sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals,
  SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS xg,
  SUM(pss.xg_pss) - SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS xg_minus_goals
FROM player_season_stats AS pss
JOIN seasons AS s
  ON s.season_id = pss.season_id
JOIN competitions AS c
  ON c.competition_id = s.competition_id
JOIN players AS p
  ON p.player_id = pss.player_id
WHERE s.season = '2023-2024'
  AND c.league_code = 'ENG-PL'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10
ORDER BY xg_minus_goals DESC, p.player_id
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Use player_season_stats for goals_pss and xg_pss, filtered via seasons.season = '2023-2024'. Grain is player-season-team, so aggregate by player_id across any club rows in the season: SUM(goals_pss), SUM(xg_pss), compute xG_minus_goals = SUM(xg_pss) - SUM(goals_pss), filter SUM(goals_pss) >= 10, then order xG_minus_goals DESC LIMIT 1. Join players by player_id for player_name; join teams by team_id only if club display is needed.
